description: Listed Building consent for the conversion of office space to create four houses with private amenity space and bin and cycle storage incorporating internal and external alterations
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: Construction & Environment Management Plan, Flood Risk Assessment, Heritage Statement, Addendum Heritage Statement; Noise Impact Assessment,  Planning, Design, & Access Statement, Fire Statement, Marketing Report, Air Quality Assessment; Energy Statement; W1130-100, jw1130 - 101-A, jw1130 - 102, jw1130 - 103-A, jw1130 - 104-A, jw1130 - 105, jw1130 - 106-C, jw1130 - 107-C, jw1130 - 108-B, jw1130 - 109, jw1130 - 110-B, jw1130 - 111, jw1130 - 112, jw1130 - 113, jw1130 - 114, jw1130 - 115, jw1130 - 116-A, w1130 - 117-A, w1130 - 118-A, w1130 - 119-A, w1130 - 120-A, jw1130-121, jw1130-122, jw1130-123-A, jw1130-124-A, jw1130 - 125, jw1130-126, jw1130-127, jw1130-128, jw1130-129, Received: 17/05/2023; 15/08/2023; 09/11/2023; 17/04/2024.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of any development hereby approved a vertical services strategy method statement for foul drainage associated with new bathrooms in the proposed dwellings shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and once approved such details as agreed will be strictly adhered to unless otherwise agreed in writing by the LPA.
